scope: Explain the environment-versus-explicit-project-property mismatch using one already-observed isolated current-host shell transport control and pinned cached bytecode. This receipt neither reruns Gradle nor rewrites the failed historical run or its context review.

conclusions.summary: With only three harmless literal environment entries, direct isolated Python received ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_kotlin.user.home, while the same child launched through /bin/sh (dash) did not; the underscore-named control survived both. The hash-identical original gradlew selects /bin/sh. Cached Gradle strips exactly ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_; cached KGP reads the exact kotlin.user.home Gradle property before falling back to user.home/.kotlin if absent. Thus shell transport is a concrete current-host mechanism consistent with the old default-home output, not evidence that KGP inherently ignores environment properties and not a capture of the old JVM.
conclusions.actionable_next_step: Use the bounded existing JS/Wasm run-only --kotlin-user-home option, which emits an explicit -Pkotlin.user.home argument, and independently inspect each fresh generated config. An argv request alone does not establish effective use; the lead owns the new run and its verification.

evidence_flow.detail: Direct child booleans are true,true,true; /bin/sh child booleans are false,false,true. No inherited environment was passed. This proves loss across the selected current-host shell route, not every shell/platform or the original JVM.

Shebang is #!/bin/sh, wrapper Java arguments retain the caller's "$@", and exec "$JAVACMD" "$@" launches the JVM. The current wrapper SHA equals the failed Wasm001 inputs-before binding. Only the wrapper source is hash-bound historically; historical /bin/sh executable identity was not captured.

The environment loader requests names with ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_, then removes exactly prefix.length() characters using String.substring. These operations do not replace or discard dots. This does not prove an entry reached the historical loader or resolve all project-property precedence.

The separate loader obtains StartParameterInternal.getProjectPropertiesUntracked(). The successful historical cold diagnostic requested -Pkotlin.user.home explicitly; its archived observed process-launch cwd is the prepared tooling directory.

evidence_flow.detail: The home accessor passes the named property and project to PropertiesBuildService, then obtains the provider's nullable value. Providers are keyed by project path/property; this inspection does not reconstruct historical service state.

The callable checks extra properties first (0-19), ProviderFactory.gradleProperty(name).getOrNull second (23-48), then local properties (52-71). No actual local/global private properties or historical provider values were inspected.

A nonnull getKotlinUserHomeDir value constructs File(value); otherwise the fallback is File(System.getProperty("user.home")) resolved with .kotlin. A generated default path alone does not prove the original accessor was null rather than explicitly set to that same path.

The private kotlinToolingSetup method (not apply) sets the tooling default-installation provider from getUserKotlinPersistentDir and the companion tooling-directory name, zipped with the package-manager provider. The full selected method is included; the runtime effective provider was not executed by this review.
